items.title: Accelerate refactored mainframe performance tuning with Kiro Power
items.summary: Your modernized mainframe application passes functional testing but fails its performance targets. Each fix takes a developer 1–2 days of manual analysis. In this post, we show how a Kiro Power cuts the remediation to hours by identifying performance hotspots and proposing proven remediation patterns that you review and approve.
